instruction: Complete the task in OpenSCAD through visible GUI interaction only. Launch OpenSCAD from `/usr/bin/openscad` and use its editor and preview controls. Do not use a terminal, command-line rendering, or external scripts to bypass GUI actions. Use the accompanying reference image supplied with this message as the visual projection; it is not uploaded into the environment. Use the accompanying reference image, `dimensions.csv`, and `inspection_report.txt` to re-create the wafer carrier as a parametric OpenSCAD model. Define `module wafer_carrier`, implement the concentric opening, raised lip, and three equally spaced through locating holes, invoke the module once, and save `/home/user/Desktop/answer.scad`.
